resources.string: Turn this on once. After that, opening a prediction market app is all it takes - the American odds appear over the percentages on their own, and it switches off when you leave the app or after a few minutes idle.
On the next screen, find Odds Converter under Downloaded apps and turn it on. On Android 13+ you may first need to allow restricted settings from the app info menu.
Works in: %1$s - and any app you add.
Reads the on-screen odds in prediction market apps so it can show them as American odds. Nothing leaves the device.
Shows American odds over percentages in prediction market apps.
